en.description: RentCheck gives small landlords a clear monthly view of which rent payments have arrived and which still need chasing.

landing.headline: Know exactly which rent has arrived this month
landing.subheadline: For landlords with a handful of flats who want to stop cross-referencing bank statements every month.
landing.featuresHeading: Everything a small landlord needs to stay on top of rent

features.title: Flat-by-flat status
features.description: See every flat's payment position in one list so you know immediately who has paid and who has not.

features.title: Flag late payments
features.description: Mark any payment as Pending, Paid, Late or Missing so overdue rent never hides in a long bank statement.

features.title: Monthly snapshot
features.description: Open the dashboard on any day of the month and see at a glance how many payments are still outstanding.

features.title: Board view by status
features.description: Switch to board view and drag payments from Pending to Paid as money arrives in your account.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.description: Log in with your Google account — no extra registration, no password to remember.

steps.title: Add your flats
steps.description: Enter each flat once: the tenant's name, monthly rent amount and the day payment falls due.

steps.title: Mark payments
steps.description: Tick off each payment as it arrives; flag anything late or missing with a single click.

steps.title: Check at a glance
steps.description: Return any time to see which payments are in and which still need your attention before the month ends.

items.question: How many flats can I track?
items.answer: As many as you manage. RentCheck does not impose a limit on the number of flats or payment records you can add.

items.question: Do I need to connect my bank account?
items.answer: No. You mark payments manually after checking your bank. RentCheck does not connect to any bank or financial service.

items.question: Can I review payments from previous months?
items.answer: Yes. Every record stays in your account so you can filter and review payment history from any month you choose.

items.question: Who can see my data?
items.answer: Only you. Each Google account sees only the flats and records it created — no one else has access to your data.

items.question: What if a tenant pays in two instalments?
items.answer: Add two separate payment records for that flat — one per instalment — and mark each one as it arrives.

dashboard.title: Your Rent Dashboard
